finding: No security response headers: no HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy
evidence: Response headers of https://www.kavaiyatech.com/ (server: Apache, x-provided-by: StackCDN) list none of them
recommended fix: Add the six headers at the CDN/Apache (.htaccess). Start CSP in report-only mode.

finding: No Cache-Control/Expires on any static asset; repeat visits re-download everything
evidence: Headers for css/style.css, js/*.js, assets/logo.png; Lighthouse cache insight: 163 KiB re-fetched
recommended fix: Set long max-age + immutable on versioned CSS/JS/images; short TTL on HTML.

finding: Logo is a 1080x1080 PNG (53 KB) shown at 38 px in the header and reused as favicon and share image
evidence: assets/logo.png; header img width/height 1080 attrs; Lighthouse image-delivery insight ~52 KiB savings
recommended fix: Export 64/128/512 px WebP/PNG/SVG variants; serve responsive sizes.

finding: Favicon is the large PNG; /favicon.ico returns 404; no apple-touch-icon or web manifest
evidence: curl /favicon.ico = 404; <link rel=icon href=assets/logo.png> only
recommended fix: Add favicon.ico/SVG, 180 px apple-touch-icon, manifest.

finding: Share card uses the square logo (summary card), no 1200x630 image, no og:image dimensions
evidence: meta og:image and twitter:card=summary in page head
recommended fix: Create a 1200x630 branded share image; switch to summary_large_image; add width/height.

finding: JS and CSS are not minified (about 7 KiB and 6 KiB gzip savings)
evidence: Lighthouse unminified-javascript / unminified-css on mirrored files
recommended fix: Add a minify step in the build/deploy.

finding: Colour-contrast failure in the publication preview ('DOCUMENT ID' label and 'JULY 2026' date)
evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast: div.paper-visual > .paper-sheet > .paper-code small; .paper-date span
recommended fix: Raise text/background contrast to 4.5:1 for small text.

finding: Heading order skips a level in the hero (h3#intelActiveProgram follows h1); page uses 9 h2, 43 h3, 37 h4
evidence: Lighthouse heading-order; DOM counts
recommended fix: Use h2 for section titles, h3 for sub-items; keep visual size in CSS.

finding: robots.txt advertises a private path (/kt-private/)
evidence: https://www.kavaiyatech.com/robots.txt
recommended fix: Protect with authentication, remove the Disallow line that names it.

finding: No DMARC record; DKIM selector not confirmed; no CAA record. SPF exists and is strict (v=spf1 include:spf.stackmail.com a mx -all)
evidence: Public DNS via DoH 2026-10-03: TXT kavaiyatech.com; _dmarc TXT empty; CAA empty; default/google DKIM selectors empty (StackMail selector unknown)
recommended fix: Publish DMARC (p=none then quarantine), confirm DKIM in StackMail, add CAA. Mail spoofing of the brand is otherwise unmonitored.

finding: Apex domain kavaiyatech.com answers 200 instead of redirecting to www (canonical on page points to www)
evidence: HEAD https://kavaiyatech.com/ = 200; http://www -> 301 to https://www is correct
recommended fix: 301 apex to www (or vice versa) at DNS/CDN level.

finding: Unknown URLs return the default Apache 'Not Found' page (plain, iso-8859-1), no branded 404
evidence: curl https://www.kavaiyatech.com/nonexistent-page = 404 default page
recommended fix: Add a branded 404 with links to Home, Services, Contact.

finding: Chat-assistant script requests api/assistant/status and the live endpoint returns 404
evidence: GET https://www.kavaiyatech.com/api/assistant/status = 404; js/assistant.js line 68. Whether a visible widget appears to users is Not verified
recommended fix: Confirm intent; either restore the endpoint or remove the dead scripts/CSS.

finding: Live site returned HTTP 403 to headless-Chrome/Lighthouse user-agents from the audit environment while plain curl got 200; wp-login.php also 403
evidence: curl with Chrome-like UAs = 403 (2026-10-03). Cause (WAF rule vs. egress IP) Not verified. Googlebot behaviour Not verified
recommended fix: Check CDN/WAF bot rules in Search Console (URL Inspection) and PageSpeed Insights so crawlers and monitors are not blocked.

finding: No analytics or tag manager found; no visibility into traffic, sources or conversions
evidence: No gtag/GTM/Plausible/Matomo in page HTML; Search Console status Not verified
recommended fix: Verify Search Console + Bing Webmaster; add privacy-friendly analytics with goals (WhatsApp click, email click, form submit).

finding: Stats band conflicts with content: '02 digital/YouTube channels' but no YouTube link anywhere; '03 countries' while Dubai is labelled 'planned'; ISO shown as 'application in progress'
evidence: Home page About stats band vs Global footprint and footer
recommended fix: Reword stats to what is verifiable or link the channels.

finding: Naming varies: KT INDIA / KT India / Kavaiya Technologies India (Private Limited) / domain kavaiyatech.com; title tag says 'KT INDIA' only
evidence: title, alt text, JSON-LD alternateName, footer
recommended fix: Pick one display name ('Kavaiya Technologies (KT INDIA)') and use it everywhere incl. profiles.

finding: Mobile lab performance 69/100: Total Blocking Time 1,370 ms, LCP 2.6 s, 20 long tasks; desktop 100. Drivers: 6,900-line HTML with 527-option country list, 87 KB script.js (3.8k-line form logic), 252 KB libphonenumber loaded synchronously on every visit, 103 non-composited animations, 140 KB CSS
evidence: Lighthouse 13.5 mobile on a faithful local mirror (see audit-report section 3). Live-site Lighthouse blocked by 403
recommended fix: Load phone validation only when the careers form is opened; defer scripts; lazy-render below-fold sections (content-visibility); use transform/opacity animations; split CSS; remove the inline country list.

finding: Render-blocking CSS (~305 ms estimated) from a 140 KB stylesheet and a second stylesheet for the assistant
evidence: Lighthouse render-blocking insight
recommended fix: Inline critical CSS, load the rest async, drop unused assistant CSS.

finding: Privacy notice does not mention the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, a named grievance contact, or retention periods; careers form collects résumé, CGPA and links. Server-side form protection (rate limiting, upload validation) cannot be tested passively. Honeypot field is present
evidence: policies.html text; careers form fields in page source
recommended fix: Add a DPDP-aligned notice, retention statement and grievance contact; review api/apply.php (upload limits, rate limit, CAPTCHA/Turnstile) with the client.

finding: No business enquiry form or booking path: all eight 'REQUEST SERVICE' buttons only scroll to Contact and save the choice in local storage; the Contact section offers an email link and WhatsApp
evidence: js/script.js requestService (line ~2428); #contact section text
recommended fix: Add a short enquiry form (name, email, service, budget band, message) with spam protection, plus tel/WhatsApp/calendar options and a confirmation message.

finding: No testimonials, case studies, client names or logos anywhere, while the page claims '05 MAJOR CLIENTS'
evidence: Full text of home page; About stats band
recommended fix: Publish 2-3 case studies/testimonials with client permission, or remove/qualify the claim. Do not invent content.

finding: The offer is hard for a buyer to grasp quickly: hero is 'One technology ecosystem for research', 10 sectors across animation, games, semiconductors, 6G, plus 8 services; heavy ALL-CAPS and internal jargon. Services have no process, pricing guidance, deliverables or FAQ
evidence: Hero h1, sector directory, services section
recommended fix: Lead with the buyer problem ('Custom software, ERP/POS and AI for growing businesses in Gujarat'), keep the ecosystem story as a secondary 'About' layer, add sentence-case copy and an FAQ.

finding: Only LinkedIn and Instagram are linked; neither could be verified (sign-in wall / HTTP 429). No Facebook, X, YouTube or GitHub found. Posting cadence, engagement, bio and link-back are Not verified
evidence: social-local-competitors-raw.md section 1
recommended fix: With admin access: complete bios, link the website, set a posting plan (project updates, white paper, ANNAVEDA progress); add YouTube/GitHub only if the team will maintain them.

finding: Google Business Profile not verified; no LocalBusiness/ProfessionalService schema or map link; the address looks like a residential complex and hours are '24 hours'
evidence: Page JSON-LD types; footer; search results
recommended fix: Claim/verify GBP (service-area or storefront as applicable), add LocalBusiness schema and a Maps link, confirm the public hours.

finding: No third-party listings or reviews found (Clutch, GoodFirms, IndiaMART, JustDial, Crunchbase, Zauba/Tofler); NAP cannot be cross-checked because only the website carries it
evidence: social-local-competitors-raw.md sections 1-2
recommended fix: Create consistent profiles with identical name/address/phone and the same description; request reviews from real clients.

finding: Brand queries do not surface the company in the search tool used; spellings are confused with Kavya/Kaivalya/KT Technologies (US-only tool, so re-check in Google India)
evidence: social-local-competitors-raw.md section 3
recommended fix: Verify Search Console, submit sitemap, align names, add profiles and structured data; re-test in Google India.

finding: Structured data is a good start (Organization, Service, WebSite) but Services point to #fragments, sameAs lists 2 profiles, and there is no LocalBusiness, FAQ, SoftwareApplication or Article/ScholarlyArticle for the white paper
evidence: JSON-LD @graph in page source
recommended fix: Extend the schema when real pages exist; validate with the Rich Results test.

finding: Content lives in a hand-edited 6.9k-line HTML file with 4.2k-line JS and 8.4k-line CSS and no CMS; every text change requires editing code
evidence: Source file sizes; no CMS signatures found
recommended fix: Move to a component/static-site build with content files so edits are safe and quick.

finding: One-page architecture: sitemap lists 2 URLs; all services, sectors and research live on one ~39,000 px-tall mobile page. Service schema URLs are #fragments that search engines treat as the home page. Individual services cannot rank for their own terms
evidence: sitemap.xml; Lighthouse element positions (bottom 38,913 px on mobile); JSON-LD Service url values
recommended fix: Create real URLs: /services/, one page per service, /about/, /research/, /careers/, /contact/, case-study pages; 301-map and keep anchors working.

finding: No keyword-targeted landing pages for what buyers search (e.g. ERP/POS, custom software, smart contracts, PCB design in Gujarat)
evidence: Title/description cover one generic theme; no service pages
recommended fix: One page per service with local intent, FAQ, proof and a CTA; internal links from home.

finding: Peers in the same region have far larger indexable footprints and proof: Groovy Web ~847 sitemap URLs, case studies, testimonials, 6 social channels, G2/Manifest listings; Novumlogic ~165 URLs with blog and case studies; Vedx 3 URLs but blog and testimonials. KT INDIA has 2 URLs, no proof, 2 social links
evidence: social-local-competitors-raw.md section 4 (own-site fetches; follower counts and client numbers Not verified)
recommended fix: Phase the proof and content plan in the 30-60-90 roadmap: case studies, one useful article per month, listings, reviews.

finding: Positioning risk: breadth (10 sectors, semiconductors, 6G, games) for a 2024-founded company may dilute the commercial message to service buyers; the research story is valuable for partners and talent but is a different audience
evidence: Home page structure; founding 2024
recommended fix: Define two audiences (service clients; research/talent partners) and give each a clear path while keeping a single brand.
